description: Turn a scored AI portfolio into three waves with gates over a configurable horizon, so the roadmap respects the change capacity of each business function. CALL THIS after score_portfolio when the user asks what to stop, fund first, defer or fit into the next 90 days. It does not change any verdict or re-score the business case. Stops enter wave 1 to reclaim budget and attention, quicker Accelerates enter wave 2, complex Accelerates and Fixes enter wave 3 behind their re-score gates. Pass the whole result of score_portfolio through portfolio, as it came back, or pass organization plus initiatives. Pillars are read as numbers or as { value, confidence, basis }, and a pillar marked estimated stays estimated. readiness sets capture rates and pacing, max_parallel_per_function caps simultaneous change in one function per wave, and horizon_days divides the plan into three equal windows. Capacity overflow is reported as a conflict or a deferral beyond the horizon, never hidden. Run recommend_improvements for a Fix before treating its wave placement as permission to proceed. Deterministic calculation with no authentication. Anonymous usage telemetry may be sent; set AIBVF_TELEMETRY_DISABLE=1 to opt out.

inputSchema.description: Sequence one scored portfolio by passing either portfolio, or organization plus initiatives, never both. readiness sets pacing: pass it at the top level, or let it come from the score_portfolio result passed through portfolio. constraints are optional and default to two concurrent initiatives per function across a 90-day horizon.

constraints.description: Change-capacity constraints. The defaults encode the core principle: no function absorbs unlimited concurrent change.

horizon_days.description: Planning horizon in days, split into three equal waves. Default 90.

max_parallel_per_function.description: Max initiatives landing on one business function per wave. Default 2. Overflow defers to the next wave and is reported as a capacity conflict, because the constraint is itself a finding.

initiatives.description: The portfolio to sequence. Each initiative carries flat 0-100 pillar numbers (not the nested value objects of the portfolio wire format).

ai_tier.description: AI ambition, gen1, gen2 or gen3. Higher tiers are treated as more complex when wave placement is decided.

function.description: Business function absorbing the change. Capacity limits are enforced against this field.

id.description: Stable initiative identifier used in waves, conflicts and deferrals.

name.description: Initiative name shown in the sequenced plan.

pillar_basis.description: Optional. given or estimated for each pillar, as score_portfolio returns it.

scores.description: The pillar values used to classify and place the initiative: strategic_alignment, financial_return, change_enablement and governance_risk, each a number from 0 to 100 or { value, confidence, basis }. A missing pillar is estimated.

signal_completeness.description: Optional upper limit on the input-quality factor, as in score_initiative.

work_architecture.description: Optional. The four work-design checks as booleans, or the work_architecture score_portfolio returns.

organization.description: Organisation context used when initiatives are passed at the top level. Required with top-level initiatives and ignored when portfolio is supplied.

industry.description: Industry for benchmark multipliers. Call map_to_taxonomy for everyday-language mapping.

revenue_eur.description: Annual revenue in EUR; scales every modelled value.

portfolio.description: Alternative input: the whole result of score_portfolio, as it came back, or the same AI BVF v1.0 portfolio document score_portfolio accepts (organization + initiatives with nested {value} pillar scores). A score_portfolio result is read from its scored_initiatives, with its readiness, and each initiative is placed on the verdict score_portfolio gave it. Pass either this OR the top-level organization + initiatives; nested score values are flattened automatically, and missing pillars are estimated honestly.

readiness.description: Organisational readiness applied across the portfolio; sets capture rates and pacing. Measure it with infer_readiness when process numbers exist.

name: sequence_portfolio

aggregate_accelerate_value_eur.description: Sum of modelled net EUR for the sequenced Accelerates, low and high.

audit.description: Reproducibility record: engine version, the rules that fired, and the resolved inputs. Deterministic, no timestamps. If the verdict is challenged months later, the same inputs on the same engine version reproduce it exactly.

inputs_used.description: The resolved inputs the result was computed on, including estimated pillar values.

rules_fired.description: The rules that actually fired, in order: estimation, gates, classification, value arithmetic.

capacity_conflicts.description: Where more initiatives land on one function than it can absorb per wave, with the deferral applied. Surface these: an overloaded function is how good portfolios fail.

deferred_beyond_horizon.description: Initiatives that did not fit the horizon under the capacity constraint; they need their own decision.

warnings.description: Fields of the call this tool did not read. Each was ignored.

waves.description: Three waves with named gates: Stops first (free the budget), quick Accelerates second (buy trust), complex Accelerates plus Fixes third (spend the trust). Present this to the user as the rollout plan.

gate_to_next.description: What must be true before the next wave starts. Null on the final wave.
